character.prompt: A sturdy blacksmith woman with a powerful, broad-shouldered build, standing in a confident side-profile stance. She wears a soot-stained leather apron over a rolled-up tunic, heavy-duty work gloves, and thick boots. Her thick blonde braid hangs over one shoulder, and she holds a heavy iron smithing hammer resting against her shoulder. Her expression is focused and capable, with subtle muscle definition in her arms and a clean, selective outline style.
